Chapter.Heading: Installing and loading the Cubefree package
Chapter.Section: Installing the Cubefree package installing the &Cubefree; package The installation of the &Cubefree; package follows standard &GAP; rules, see also Section in the &GAP; reference manual. So the standard method is to unpack the package into the pkg directory of your &GAP; distribution. This will create a cubefree subdirectory.

Loading the Cubefree package loading the &Cubefree; package To use the &Cubefree; Package you have to request it explicitly. This is done by calling LoadPackage like this:
gap> LoadPackage("cubefree"); true
